transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I feel like I’ve lost my drive and personality—I don’t have the energy or motivation to do anything, even the art and routines that used to keep me going. Everything just feels completely exhausting, and I don't know how to get back to who I was.
Have you felt this way consistently for at least two years, or is this a more recent change that has lasted for a few weeks or months?

It's definitely not a recent change—I've been feeling this heavy and drained for a little over two years now. It started shortly after my divorce, and it's just been a constant weight ever since. I'm honestly so exhausted from carrying this around for this long.

During these past two years, have there been any periods of a few weeks or more where your mood felt significantly worse, perhaps feeling like you couldn't function at all or felt completely hopeless?

To be honest, it hasn't really come in short phases—that heavy, hopeless feeling has been there almost constantly for the entire two years. It's like a continuous dark cloud that rarely ever lifts, making it incredibly hard to function most of the time. It just feels like a permanent weight rather than something that comes and goes.
During these past two years, have you experienced persistent changes in your appetite, sleep patterns, or concentration alongside this low mood?

Yes, all of those have been really bad. My appetite is almost gone, so I usually just eat one cheap meal late at night and my pants are hanging loose from losing so much weight. I also lie awake for hours worrying, wake up around 3 or 4 a.m. unable to sleep, and my concentration has been so shot for the last two years that I can barely manage my job or basic routines.
During these past two years, have there been any periods lasting longer than two months where you felt like your mood and energy levels returned to your normal baseline?

No, I haven't had any periods over the last two years where I felt back to my normal self. This heavy, drained feeling has been there almost constantly, and even during a stretch last summer when I wasn't quite as sad, I still just felt completely flat and empty.

During these two years, have you experienced periods where your symptoms were so severe that they met the full criteria for a major depressive episode, such as feeling completely worthless or having thoughts that life is not worth living?

Yes, I've felt that way almost the entire time. I constantly feel completely worthless, like a burden who has ruined my ex-wife's life and let everyone at my job down. It's so heavy that I often feel like I deserve to be punished because I just screw up everything I touch.
